page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top, with the page number at the top right. Below the text, a centred heading in capitals, followed by one more paragraph of text. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: phetis & Apostolis acceptam, incorrupte in Scholis, Ecclesijsq; docere. Dogmata pugnantia cum verbo Dei, quantumuis λόγῳ[?] τῆς σοφίας[?] habeant, nulla, vel feminare vel tueri Eruditioni ac gradui, morum gravitatem, sermone & actionibus expressam, coniungere. Commoda vtilitatemq; nostræ Academiæ, acinprimis ordinis Theologici, quantum in te fuerit, perpetuo promouere. Indignos ambitiosos, contentiosos à dignitatis titulo, quem Docturam appellat longè abarcere. Deniq; cū vniuersis fratribus sincera religione profitetibus, τῷ φιλα-δελφίαν[?], insigne coniunctionis vinculum colere, alere æternum, Amen.
main_text.head: RENUNCIATIO POST EXACTUM & præstitum iusiurandum.
main_text.p: Quandoquidem illustri hominum illu-strium testimonio, vita antea acta, virtus, ministerium & doctrina D. Iohannis Hardij magnpere nostro Collegio commedata: & publicè priuatimque ijs, quæ lege mo-req; laudabili ab eodem requisita sunt, præclarè ab eode satisfactum est: nec etiā nobis est dubium, magno ornameto & vsui ordinis Theologorum tore hunc præstante virum, q; posteaq; multis annis Ecclesiæ dei fideliter

page.notes: Printed text is mostly clear. Doubtful readings: the Greek words (λόγῳ, τῆς σοφίας, τῷ φιλα-δελφίαν), which are marked [?]. The first word "phetis" is a fragment at the top of the page and is kept as printed. "magnpere", "eode" and "posteaq;" are printed as they stand. The page number reads 231 as printed.
